name: Inspect secured voice studio and engine requirement
description: Verifies the real ChatterboxVC engine dependency is stated rather than claiming to run inference without a configured GPU.
steps: Open the app in a signed-out browser
Inspect the conversion workspace and model status card
Confirm the app offers a sign-in control and indicates GPU connection is required
expected: The page clearly identifies ChatterboxVC and notes a separate GPU engine is required. It does not claim to have generated audio.

name: Reject conversion without uploaded files
description: Verifies an empty request cannot start a voice-conversion job on mobile.
steps: Open the studio at mobile viewport
Without selecting either audio file, press Generate cloned voiceover
expected: A visible message asks for both an original voiceover and a target voice sample; no output is shown.

name: Choose export format and confirm consent independently
description: Verifies users can select WAV or MP3 and affirm permission without initiating voice conversion.
steps: Select WAV as the output format
expected: The highlighted export-format selection switches correctly and the consent checkbox stays checked.

name: Show accurate explanation of requirements
description: Verifies that the technical notes show the hosting and GPU requirements and can be expanded on small screens.
steps: Scroll to the Quick Start panel
Press Technical notes to expand it
expected: The technical notes explain that the AI runs on a separate GPU-enabled server and does not use a paid conversion API.
